issues.description: The Stock.findStockIngredient method signature in the template repository does not match the signature in the problem specification and the solution. The template defines findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) while the UML and the solution expect findStockIngredient(String). This mismatch also causes internal calls in the template (e.g., add and take) to call a single-parameter findStockIngredient, which will not resolve correctly and leads to a compilation error. Students will be blocked or confused when implementing SealSaloon that relies on stock.findStockIngredient(name).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock.findStockIngredient method match the specification/solution by providing a single-parameter signature: public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { ... }. Alternatively, add a one-parameter overload that delegates to the two-parameter version (e.g., public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { return findStockIngredient(name, true); }). Ensure the implementation and internal calls use the single-parameter method so code compiles and matches the UML.
